embeds.title: 🔴 Hackers Exploit FortiClient EMS Flaw to Push Infostealer Malware
embeds.description:
Hackers are exploiting CVE-2026-35616, an authentication bypass vulnerability in FortiClient Enterprise Management Server (EMS), to deliver the EKZ credential stealer. Arctic Wolf observed attacks leveraging the vulnerability to deliver malware disguised as Fortinet endpoint updates through VPN scripting workflows. The malware exfiltrates browser credentials, credit card details, and cookies. Fortinet confirmed exploitation in early April and released emergency hotfixes. CISA ordered federal agencies to secure instances, and The Shadowserver Foundation reported 2,000 internet-exposed EMS instances.
**Sources:** BleepingComputer • 🔴 1 corroborating
**CVEs:** CVE-2026-35616 • **Access:** Authentication bypass vulnerability in FortiClient EMS allowing unauthenticated remote code execution via specially crafted requests
**Incident date:** 2026-04 • **Confidence:** claim
